text: Based on the output, the property remained free of fires throughout the period from October 5, 2026, to November 4, 2026. The data from NASA FIRMS, which includes detections from VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS, shows zero fire detections intersecting the asset. Although there was a gap in coverage on November 3 and 4, 2026, due to the latest NRT file update, the majority of the period was covered, and no fires were detected. Therefore, it is reasonable to conclude that the property stayed free of fires during the specified period.
